fixes.explanation: Yes, baker, it's False. Jesus says the wicked servant 'begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.' That's what Jesus tells us he does. Giving the others their food at the proper time is what the faithful servant does (Matthew 24:45). He's the one the master finds doing so when he returns (Matthew 24:46).
